title: Better With Bigshrooms (Huge Mushroom Backport)
description: This mod adds huge mushrooms to Minecraft BTA! 8.0.
body:
# Better with Bigshrooms
This mod backports huge mushrooms to Minecraft BTA! 8.0. They can be found in various forest biomes, and can be manually created by using bonemeal on a small mushroom. Their blocks can be harvested using gold tools.
